title: Rename input box opens outside Godot
body: ### Tested versions Reproducible in: v4.7.dev5.official [a8643700c] Not reproducible in: v4.6.2.stable.official [71f334935] ### System information Godot v4.7.dev5 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - GeForce GTX 550 Ti - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-2100 CPU @ 3.10GHz (4 threads) - 11.95 GiB memory ### Issue description The rename node input box opens outside Godot when: - multiple nodes are selected - a specific node is clicked (see below) - Godot's window width is 1056 or less If the rename node input box opens at all, depends on: - if the modifier shift or ctrl was held when selecting the nodes - if the mouse pointer moved over the viewport before clicking on a selected node The rename input box opens when: - Shift selecting multiple nodes and clicking on the first selected node from the top - Ctrl selecting multiple nodes and clicking on the last selected node There's no rename input box when: - clicking below the first selected node from the top, if they were shift selected - clicking on a selected node before the last selected, if they were ctrl selected - the mouse pointer is moved over the viewport before clicking on a selected node When the issue doesn't happen: The rename input box opens in-line with the node name, in v4.6.2.stable.official [71f334935] or when: - right-clicking and choosing: rename - pressing: f2 There's an issue about the rename input box only opening when selecting some selected nodes: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/97702#issuecomment-4311869512 ### Steps to reproduce - open the project: [rename-input-box-outside-godot.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27047802/rename-input-box-outside-godot.zip) - resize Godot's window to it's minimum size (only tested in Win 11 where it's 1026x632) - in the scene panel, with these nodes: ``` Node2D - Node2D2 - Node2D3 ``` - click on the last node: Node2D3 - hold shift and click on the root node: Node2D - release shift and click on the root node: Node2D ### Expected: A rename input box shouldn't open outside Godot, but in this case the expected behavior is most likely that a rename input box shouldn't open at all, instead the other nodes should just be deselected (as it already does). Because currently it requires an extra step if one want to select one of multiple selected nodes: - click outside the rename input box to close it - or press esc to close the rename input box In both cases the target node remains selected. If the intention is to rename one of the selected nodes, then renaming would just take two clicks: - the first click would deselect the other nodes - the second click would show the rename input box for that node If the intention is to rename all selected nodes, then it already works to: - right-click and choose rename - press f2 ### Issue: The rename input box opens outside Godot. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8ce0bb59-bd69-4104-8ad2-7bd513d9555c The rename input box opens in-line with the node name when Godot's window width is resized to 1057 or more. ### How to show the window size One way to show the window size is to take a window screenshot: Alt + PrintScreen then open the screenshot in an image viewer/editor. Or if you have AutoHotkey (windows automation scripting) installed, it comes with an app called: Window Spy It shows real-time window properties, including the size. To resize a window precisely, win 11 has move and size options in the title bar right-click menu. - Right-click Godot's title bar, choose: size - A crosshair appears in the center of the window. - Press: right arrow to move the mouse pointer to the window's right edge - Hold ctrl and press left or right to resize by 1px (11px without ctrl) - Press: enter to accept the new size ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [rename-input-box-outside-godot.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27047802/rename-input-box-outside-godot.zip)
